a.xlink:title: Conversation 1 to Message 0..N: Each message belongs to one Conversation
Event 1 to Conversation 0..N: One Event per Conversation
Event 1 to Team 0..N: Each Team belongs to one Event
Event 1 to AgentMessage 0..N: One Event for each AI history row
Event 1 to HelpRequest 0..N: One Event per help request
Team 0..1 to Conversation 0..1: Unique partial index on Team conversation; only for kind=team
Team 0..N to Profile 1..N: Each Team contains its owner; each Profile belongs to at most one Team per Event
Profile 1..N to Conversation 0..N: Embedded members with user ObjectId ref; DM has exactly 2
Profile 0..1 to Conversation 0..N: Conditional DM references, each optional field
Profile 1 to Team 0..N: Each Team has one owner
Profile 1 to AgentMessage 0..N: One Profile for each AI history row
Profile 1 to HelpRequest 0..N: Each help request has one hacker
Profile 0..1 to HelpRequest 0..N: Open requests have no mentor
Profile 0..1 to Message 0..N: System messages do not have senders
HelpRequest 0..1 to Conversation 0..1: Unique partial index; only for kind=mentor
